facts.statement: A French-language SOE news post promoted a video by the Referee Ruby about looting with the Pirates theme products and gathering gold coins in Free Realms.
facts.quote: Vidéo sur le Pillage Pirates Par Arbitre Ruby!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a French-language official freerealms.com news post, showing a video in which the Referee Ruby ("l'Arbitre Ruby") guides players through the Pirates theme products and how to collect gold coins (pièces d'or) in Free Realms. The page gives no exact date beyond a relative 'posted 11 months, 6 days ago' stamp, so the post dates to roughly mid-2010 relative to the June 2011 capture. It contains no concrete numbers, prices or mechanics.
